Most people are using AI wrong. They're treating it like a fancy assistant instead of building actual SYSTEMS that scale.

In this exclusive livestream, I'm pulling back the curtain with my First Movers team—Community Leader Joshua Cazoe, and AI Systems Lead Jason Alberti—to show you EXACTLY how we built a seven-figure business in under a year using completely AI-driven marketing automation.

No theory. No fluff. Just the actual systems, workflows, and infrastructure that took us from zero to $100K/month.

What we're revealing:

  The AI stack + clone (Dr. McCoy) that runs our entire marketing operation
  How I eliminated 90% of manual work while INCREASING conversion rates
  The automation sequences we use daily
  Our "Clone to Scale" methodology applied to an entire business operation
  The biggest mistakes we made (so you don't have to)
  Real numbers, real systems, real results

This isn't about working WITH AI. It's about building a business that RUNS on AI.
